title: Btree sharability and VDBE database-usage/shared-cache lock masks

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeSharable and sqlite3VdbeUsesBtree establish the prepared-statement database-use mask and the shared-cache lock subset. Exact Btree/BtLock layout is required because sharability is a source field rather than a delegated API property.
excluded_responsibilities: Btree enter/leave and shared-cache lock acquisition

external_source_responsibilities: Exact sqlite3.aDb/nDb and Db.pBt owners already represented
dependencies.caller_closure: Both active functions and every active-profile field of Btree/BtLock are assigned. Shared-cache mutex/lock execution and code-generator callers remain separate.

inputs: live Btree for direct sharability read; Vdbe with valid database index and live Db.pBt
outputs: 0/nonzero sharable result; cumulative btreeMask and lockMask
contracts.ownership: No allocation or ownership transfer. Btree, Db array, and Vdbe remain caller/connection-owned.
contracts.state_and_results: Every valid index sets btreeMask. lockMask is set only for non-TEMP indexes whose Btree.sharable is nonzero. Existing mask bits remain set.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback or I/O. This records future lock requirements; it does not acquire locks. Caller connection mutex remains an integration obligation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No failure result or allocation. Inputs are source-asserted to fit DbMask and connection nDb.

representation_differences: BtShared remains opaque because these functions do not dereference it; Btree and embedded BtLock preserve exact active-profile size, alignment, field order, and offsets.
C DbMaskSet expands to the equivalent typed u32 shift/or in Zig.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker packages three Db/Btree slots, marks main and TEMP sharable and a third database private, then calls the direct accessor and cumulative Vdbe usage function. Exact layouts are independently probed and C/Zig compare 366 observations.
oracle.normalization: All index, sharable, and mask values are exact; pointers are not compared.

assurance.oom: No allocation and no OOM branch.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; lock acquisition and mutex behavior remain integration work.
assurance.malformed_input: Source assertions require 0<=i<nDb and mask-width fit; worker exercises valid main/TEMP/attached indices.
assurance.continuation: Repeated calls preserve prior bits and correctly accumulate later database usage.
assurance.performance: One field read and constant-time mask updates preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Btree/BtLock/Db/Vdbe owners. Parser and runtime shared-cache lock callers remain handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate ParseSchema and VDBE enter/leave lock paths.

independent_review.notes: Requires shared-cache call-path integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect source compiler database-use call sites.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btreeInt.h:295-365 was reviewed completely for BtLock and Btree ownership/layout, mutex rule, sharable flag, and embedded shared-cache lock
upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:11560-11588 was reviewed for active shared-cache sqlite3BtreeSharable and adjacent connection-count semantics
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:2015-2045 was reviewed completely for database-use and shared-lock mask accumulation
src/core/internal/btree_aux.zig sharable, vdbe_aux.zig usesBtree, and exact Btree/BtLock layouts are canonical AST-hashed targets
callers: Build/DDL, alter, vacuum, pragma, incremental blob, and ParseSchema generation record all databases a VDBE may access
resolveP2Values asserts a non-reader has zero btreeMask; TakeOpArray requires no database-use ownership for detached subprograms
Runtime VDBE enter/leave uses btreeMask/lockMask to acquire shared-cache mutexes and locks in a separate integration unit
callees: sqlite3BtreeSharable directly returns p.sharable without allocation or lock action
sqlite3VdbeUsesBtree asserts index and mask widths, always ORs btreeMask, and ORs lockMask only for non-TEMP sharable Btree
DbMaskSet is an exact typed bit shift/or and repeated calls retain existing bits
assertions_branches_cleanup: Four behavior IDs cover direct return, index/mask assertions, and conditional lock mask
No ownership, callback, failure, OOM, or I/O occurs; all Btree fields are accessed under the connection mutex by caller contract
TEMP index one is deliberately excluded from lockMask even if its test fixture Btree is sharable
upstream_tests: Upstream shared-cache, attach/temp, pragma, incremental-blob, schema, and locking suites exercise mask consumers
Project builder differential packages main/TEMP/attached Btrees and compares direct sharability plus cumulative masks
Internal VDBE layout probe verifies every active Btree/BtLock field; runtime lock acquisition remains blocking
